# setup

Run the setup wizard (first-run by default; `menu` for picker, `<section>` to jump).

```text
usage: openprogram setup [-h] [[menu | <section>]]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `[menu \| <section>]` | ``menu`` opens the interactive picker; a section name (model / tools / agent / skills / ui / memory / profile / search / tts / channels / backend) jumps to that section; omit for the full first-run wizard. |
